en: Sutta Nipāta 5.13 Bhadrāvudha’s Questions “[Tell me of] the one who has abandoned the home, who cuts off craving, who is unshakable, ... [the one] who has transcended all bonds.”
"I entreat the wise one, the abandoner of delight, who has crossed the flood and is liberated,
who has abandoned the cycle of existence."
people from various regions who have gathered here,
O Hero, longing for your word, will turn away from this place.
Please explain this well to them,
for this Dhamma is known to you. "One should eliminate all craving for grasping."
'Above, below, across, and also in the middle—
whatever in the world they cling to...'"
Therefore Māra follows after that person.
a mindful bhikkhu should not cling to anything in the entire world.
"Beholding this generation clinging to the realm of death as if it were a being to be grasped.
Thus ends the twelfth inquiry of the youth Bhadrāvudha.
